QuestInfo.name: Spirit on My Shoulder
QuestInfo.0: #p1401002# contacted you to share some new intel.
QuestInfo.1: #p1401002# concluded that #p2040052#'s episode was similar to a phenomenon called #rspirit possession#k, where a soul enters another person's body. #b#p1061011##k in #b#m105000000##k is supposed to be an expert on that stuff.
QuestInfo.2: #p1061011# said that a soul is hanging on to your back.  Could it be the same one that took over Wiz?

0.0: I got it, captain! I know what controlled #p2040052#! I think it was a ritual called #bspirit possession#k, allowing a soul to enter another person's body. That thing you saw taking off, that was another person's soul! Isn't that gross?!
0.1: I even found you an expert! Go into the #b#m105000000##k and look for a guy named #b#p1061011##k. He's into all that weird mumbo-jumbo!

yes.0: This spirit stuff really spooks me out. I nearly gave myself a heart attack reading up on it. I bet you're okay though, huh, captain? You fought the Black Mage! Stay brave and talk to that weirdo #p1061011# in #m105000000#, okay?

no.0: Hey! I spent all my time on finding this stuff! I hope you get possessed!

1.0: Wh-what is that thing on your back?! Why have you brought this unholy terror to me?!

yes.0: I must gather my mental acumen and ignore the horrible nether-beast that resides upon this poor fool's back.

npc.0: #m105000000# is the center of Victoria Island, how have you not gotten there yet?
